adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (timestamped events, emotions and preferences) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
